parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description:
The streaming domain name.

To specify multiple domain names, separate them with commas (,).

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query. The end time must be later than the start time. Specify the time in the *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm:ss*Z format. The time must be in UTC.

parameters.name: IspNameEn
parameters.description:
The name of the carrier.

You can call the [DescribeCdnRegionAndIsp](~~91077~~) operation to obtain the carrier name.

parameters.name: LocationNameEn
parameters.description:
The name of the region.

You can call the [DescribeCdnRegionAndIsp](~~91077~~) operation to obtain the region name.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description:
The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm:ss*Z format. The time must be in UTC.

> If you do not specify this parameter, data in the last hour is queried.
